expected: Previous rate activated. Affected anniversaries replayed. Layers resized, premiums, commission and cessions adjusted. Corrected notices sent. Those who declined on the wrong figure asked again

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 3 and S24: truncated file confirmed in error
expected: Correcting file reinstates members with original join dates and no gap. Invoice adjustment nets to zero. Claim in the gap assessed on corrected membership

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 4: price error after withdrawals
expected: Fund's price activation suspended until the corrected price is approved, then as INV-010

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 5: reinsurer listing does not reconcile
expected: Settlement held for the period. Accumulation rebuild finds the mis-cession. Supplementary listing sent before paying

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 6: commission cycle paid the wrong parties after a rule was activated with the wrong dates
expected: Next run held for affected books. Events replayed. Differences post between payees. Statements reissued as new versions

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 7: benefit run fails part way
expected: Same file not resubmitted. Bank confirms accepted items. Rest go in a new run. Nobody paid twice even if the bank's confirmation is late

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 8: renewal notice sent with wrong content
expected: Template disabled. Recipients found from notification events. Correction with proof of delivery. Mandatory notice treated as not given and its clock restarted

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 9: a lapse ran without a confirmed notice
expected: Reinstated by command with no gap and no conditions. Write-offs and clawbacks reversed. Proper notice sent. Sequence restarts from the valid step

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 10: definitions version activated in error
expected: Previous version activated. Covers rebound. Claims assessed in the window reassessed

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 11: wrong surrender factor table
expected: Previous version activated. Billing, surrenders and maturities replayed. Overcharges refunded with interest where required. Undercharges absorbed by default

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Runbook 12: entitlement mapping granted too much
expected: Previous mapping activated. Grants revoked through priority channel. Every action under the wrong entitlement reviewed. Privacy assesses notifiable breach

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: Any remediation case
expected: Closes only when every affected policy is adjusted or excluded with a reason. Adjustments idempotent per policy and case

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: S5: the merchant's own scheme premium fails because its card was among those compromised
expected: Failure tied to the incident. Scheme standing and fees remediated. Merchant told it is treated as a victim

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: S9: cyclone. Regional premium relief
expected: Override applied in bulk by a population query on region, each policy evented and customer told. Undeliverable notices pause lapses in the region

design_sections: Insurance-specific incident runbooks
scenario: S9: claims from fake relief agencies and a surge of real ones
expected: Fraud rules run on the surge. Real claims keep their service timers. Bulk remittances with poor references go through matching and suspense with owners

scenario: Template review
expected: Plain-language and accessibility requirements checked. Translation versioned together with the primary

scenario: Template references a field the product does not supply
expected: Rendering test fails before activation

design_sections: Policy documents and correspondence lifecycle; Worked example: one person, several hats
scenario: Mandatory notice by post
expected: Proof of delivery recorded. Anything depending on the notice waits for it

design_sections: Policy documents and correspondence lifecycle; Worked example: one person, several hats
scenario: Scheme invoice, family renewal notice and a claim letter for the same person
expected: Invoice to the work address, renewal home, claim letter to personal contact points by default

design_sections: Policy documents and correspondence lifecycle; Worked example: one person, several hats
scenario: Correspondence on her own policies and on the partnership's
expected: Addressed to her by her relationship's contact points. No template assumes a primary owner

design_sections: Policy documents and correspondence lifecycle; Worked example: one person, several hats
scenario: Error found in an issued document
expected: Never edited. New version with a reason. Both visible to the customer

design_sections: Policy documents and correspondence lifecycle; Worked example: one person, several hats
scenario: Contact point changed on the party
expected: Every relationship using it updates. Choosing a different one for a relationship changes only that relationship

scenario: A clause used by ten products is changed
expected: One change record. Register shows ten products affected

expected: Loaded through ordinary commands with a migrated flag and original dates. Bound to legacy wording by hash. File stored as received

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Legacy system has no evidence of an underwriting decision
expected: Unknown-terms marker and a case. Never defaulted to standard rates

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Legacy exclusion clause with no clean code
expected: Carried as a verbatim-clause code pointing at the original wording. Nothing widened or narrowed

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Policy mid-grace at cutover
expected: Keeps standing and dates. Arrives at the dunning step its age implies. No notice sent twice

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Premium holiday granted in 2020
expected: Override loads with its original dates

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Legacy holds only a current sum insured
expected: Loads as a single layer with the assumption recorded

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Joint cover held as one record with two names and a paper assignment
expected: Lives separated into parties through matching. Interest loaded with its original notice date. Unclear interest flagged and restricted

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Cohort load
expected: Migration clearing accounts per cohort, currency and unit type return to zero. Reconciled to control totals to the cent and the count

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Parallel run for one billing cycle
expected: Premiums, earning, commission, cessions, invoices and statements compared line by line

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Legacy single agent code
expected: Fills writing, servicing and entitlement with the assumption recorded. Mapping checked against what each payee was last paid

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Per-life accumulation after load
expected: Rebuilt from migrated covers and compared with legacy retention records before cutover

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Annuity in payment
expected: Migrates with layers, liability, payment history, proof-of-life status and next due date. First run reconciles to the legacy run

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Income protection claim in payment at cutover
expected: Schedule, offsets, indexation history and next review date carried. First payment matches the last from the old system

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Unit-linked cohort
expected: Cutover on a pricing boundary. Units reconciled across legacy, core, administrator and custodian

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Abandon a cohort before the directory flips
expected: Load discarded. Nothing changed for anyone

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Surrender basis held in a workbook
expected: Captured as a table and proven against legacy values across a grid of ages and durations

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: S26: trial load of the synthetic legacy book
expected: Exceptions produced equal the exceptions the book was built to produce, by type and count

design_sections: Migration plan; migration notes in each section
scenario: Legacy free-text vulnerability notes
expected: Reviewed by a trained person before any becomes a marker
